question: Do independently rendered sparse Half checkpoints preserve R76 terminal replay equality, and can predicted-divergence checkpoints distinguish f32-final from f32-staged?
adversarial_selection: Before observed prefix rendering, scan predicted f32-final versus f32-staged states; retain first, global-maximum and last divergent steps and their +/-1 neighbours; union fixed prefixes; maximum 16 checkpoints.

acceptance.independence: every checkpoint is a separate full-frame render and readback
acceptance.final_control: prefix 1941 must equal a separately rendered full-frame control
acceptance.separation: terminal equality and sparse-prefix equality are distinct gates

observation_root: same Chromium/ANGLE Vulkan SwiftShader software root as R59-R76
